note: Gluetun started from the role file lemonfiber wrote for the key it minted, so the file is the one the key makes, the control server admits a request under the key and refuses one without it, and the adapter answers that Gluetun holds the key now. Taken with the stand-ins the manifest declares for OPENVPN_PASSWORD, OPENVPN_USER, VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER, VPN_TYPE, WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES, WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_IP, WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_PORT, WIREGUARD_PRESHARED_KEY, WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY, WIREGUARD_PUBLIC_KEY, never with an operator's value.
